title: 第8章 脑子是个好东西，可惜你没有！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚完结版免费阅读
content_zh: 唐逸和唐音远离状元街后，先找了一个酒楼，花了十两银子点了一桌好菜。菜刚上来，唐音抱着一只烤鸡就开吃，一边吃眼泪一边流。“哥哥，以后我们都有饭吃了，对吗？”唐音抬头看向唐逸，那张精致的小脸上全是泪水。“当然，以后我们都有饭吃了，哥哥保证。”唐逸抬手抹掉女孩脸上的泪水，以后谁敢欺负他妹，天王老子都得脱一层皮。唐音点点头，嘴角在笑，眼泪却止不住。吃饱喝足从酒楼出来，唐逸又带着唐音一起去了裁衣铺，给两人做了两身厚衣服，随即又置办了两床厚厚的被子，兄妹俩便昂首挺胸回了唐家。出去的时候是翻墙，回来的时候两人背着大包小包的东西，大摇大摆从唐家大门进去。唐敬和颜霜玉一家正在大厅吃午餐，见到唐逸和唐音穿着新衣新鞋，背着新被子回来，都愣住了。早上唐逸和唐音穿的还是粗布衣，现在，两人身上竟然是上好的锦缎。加上棉被，枕头等等，置办下来至少要五十两！他们兄妹俩哪里来的这么多钱？唐逸和唐音理都没理，转身就往西院走去。唐浩眼中闪过一抹贪婪。他当场站了起来，指着唐逸怒喝。“好啊，唐逸，原来母亲的钱是你偷的。”“你这个小偷，无耻！”唐敬脸色骤沉，看向颜霜玉。颜霜玉秒懂儿子的意思，苦涩一笑：“老爷，浩儿胡说的，没这回事。”“妾身……妾身那一百两，可能就是忘记放哪里了而已。”唐敬想到早上唐逸的落魄，再看到唐逸此时容光焕发，心头莫名有些不舒服。加上他已经下令，不准唐逸和唐音出唐家一步。结果，唐逸和唐音竟然悄悄出去了。置他的命令于不顾，置他脸面于何地？！“唐逸，听到了？你就不想解释一下吗？”唐敬放下了手中的碗筷，声音冰冷传开：“唐家家规，偷窃，杖三十，面壁三日，你想尝试一下？”唐音身躯一僵，躲在了唐逸身后，拼命摇头。上一次哥哥面壁思过，三天不给哥哥吃的，哥哥差点就饿死了。还是她悄悄从狗洞爬出去，和小狗抢了半块馒头回来，哥哥才得救呢。唐逸揉了揉唐音的脑袋，看向唐敬：“解释？唐侍郎似乎忘记了一件事，唐家现在吃的用的，都是我母亲留给我和音儿的钱。”“是颜霜玉母子，霸占了本该属于唐音和我的财产。”“别说我没偷，就算拿了，那也是我自己的钱，需要和你们报备？需要向你解释？！”“老爷。”颜霜玉泫然欲泣，道：“妾身没有想霸占小逸的财产，妾身只是担心他们兄妹二人年幼遭骗，想要替他们暂时保管一下而已。”“小逸，不许胡说，母亲勤俭持家天地可表！”唐画站了起来，看向唐逸脸上有失望：“母亲品德贤淑，你却如此侮辱母亲，这是大不孝，闹到公堂是要挨鞭刑的。”唐逸目光落在这伪君子的脸上，道：“那是你娘！我娘永远只有一个，她叫柳如玉……还有，你号称才华横溢文采风流，你是不是对品德贤淑四个字有什么误会？”“品德贤淑，你觉得你娘配这四个字？！”“你……”唐画当场被噎得脸色涨红！该死的，以前怎么没发现，这野种的嘴竟然这么毒。“少废话，唐逸，就算你巧舌如簧，也改变不了你偷母亲的钱的事实。”唐浩跳了出来，指着唐逸怒斥：“钱不是你偷的，你哪里来的钱买新衣服，买新被子的？”“你胡说，我哥哥才没偷钱！”唐音从哥哥身后露出脑袋，大声呵斥。虽然害怕，但她绝不允许任何人如此冤枉哥哥。哥哥那么厉害，往街上一坐就能赚好几百两，带着她吃好吃的，给她买新衣裳，哥哥最好了，谁都别想害哥哥。“钱是我和哥哥一起赚的，我们才没有偷钱，三哥你冤枉人。”小姑娘眼一眨，眼泪簌簌而落。“别哭，我们不需要和垃圾解释的！”唐逸抬手揉了揉女孩的脑袋。女孩仰头看着哥哥，然后用力点头。“你们一起赚的钱？哈哈，太可笑了，你们能干嘛？能赚这么多钱？”唐浩对唐音的话嗤之以鼻，冲着唐敬道：“爹，这是他们的借口，你千万别相信他们，钱……就是他们偷的。”“好了，浩儿，不许这么和弟弟说话。”颜霜玉抬手抓着唐敬的手，轻微摇了摇：“老爷，你别生气，我相信小逸只是不小心拿走了银子而已。”“说两句就好了，不要为难孩子。”“孩子做错事，我们也有责任，需要慢慢地教。”唐敬看了颜霜玉一眼，随即放下手中的筷子。在颜霜玉和唐画之间，他自然选择相信颜霜玉。“逆子，我再问你一次，银子，到底是不是偷的？”“是偷的，现在立即还回来，否则让我查实了，我打断你的腿！”唐敬向着唐逸走去，脸色阴翳道：“我可以接受你普通，也可以接受你不如你大哥，但我绝对不会接受你偷鸡摸狗，让你出去丢唐家的脸。”“现在，把剩下的银子，交出来！”颜霜玉跑过来，手抓住唐敬的手：“老爷，不要对孩子那么凶！”话落，她看向唐逸，语气焦急眼中却带着贪婪：“小逸，赶紧将剩下的银子还回来吧，你看你爹都生气了。”唐画和唐逸站在唐敬身后，也都抱着手冷笑看着唐逸。“呵，还真是阴魂不散啊！”唐逸也懒得废话了，盯着颜霜玉道：“一百两？唐二夫人，你确定是一百两？是吧？”颜霜玉微微颔首，道：“嗯，是一百两。”唐画唐浩兄弟也都冷笑不已，一个废物而已，就算走了狗屎运弄到一点银子，也不过是几十两银子而已。一百两？他这辈子别想见这么多银子！然而。下一秒，众人齐齐傻眼了。只见唐逸伸手进怀中，取出了一沓银票。指尖舔了点口水，当着他们的面一张一张地数了起来。“一百两，两百两……五百两，五百一十两，五百二十两……”唐逸扬了扬手中的银票，淡漠开口：“五百三十两，唐二夫人，真不好意思，看来这不是你丢的银票呢。”颜霜玉面色顿时火辣辣的，感觉就像是被人狠狠甩了一巴掌！
content_en: After Tang Yi and Tang Yin left Zhuangyuan Street, they first found a restaurant and spent ten taels of silver on a table of delicious dishes.As soon as the food arrived, Tang Yin started eating with a roast chicken in her arms, crying while eating."Brother, we will all have food to eat from now on, right?" Tang Yin raised his head and looked at Tang Yi, his delicate little face covered with tears."Of course, we will all have food to eat in the future, brother, I promise." Tang Yi raised his hand to wipe away the tears on the girl's face. Whoever dares to bully his sister in the future will have to shed a layer of his skin.Tang Yin nodded, smiling but unable to stop his tears.After coming out of the restaurant after eating and drinking, Tang Yi took Tang Yin to the tailor shop and made two pairs of thick clothes for the two of them. Then they bought two thick quilts, and the brother and sister returned to the Tang family with their heads held high.When they went out, they climbed over the wall. When they came back, the two of them carried large and small bags of things and walked in through the Tang family's gate.Tang Jing and Yan Shuangyu's family were having lunch in the lobby. They were stunned when they saw Tang Yi and Tang Yin coming back wearing new clothes, new shoes, and carrying new quilts.In the morning, Tang Yi and Tang Yin were still wearing coarse cloth, but now, they were wearing fine brocade.Including quilts, pillows, etc., the purchase will cost at least fifty taels!Where did the two brothers and sisters get so much money?Tang Yi and Tang Yin ignored him and turned around and walked towards the west courtyard.A flash of greed flashed in Tang Hao's eyes.He stood up on the spot, pointed at Tang Yi and shouted angrily."Okay, Tang Yi, it turns out you stole my mother's money." "You thief, shameless!" Tang Jing's face suddenly darkened and he looked at Yan Shuangyu.Yan Shuangyu immediately understood what her son meant and smiled bitterly: "Master, what Haoer said is nonsense." "I...I may have forgotten where I put the hundred taels." Tang Jing thought of Tang Yi's desolation in the morning, and saw Tang Yi's radiant face at this time, and felt inexplicably uncomfortable.In addition, he had already ordered that Tang Yi and Tang Yin were not allowed to leave the Tang family.As a result, Tang Yi and Tang Yin went out quietly.If you ignore his orders, where will you put his face?!"Tang Yi, did you hear that? Don't you want to explain?" Tang Jing put down the bowls and chopsticks in his hands, and his cold voice spread: "Tang family rules, stealing, thirty sticks, facing the wall for three days, do you want to try it?" Tang Yin froze, hid behind Tang Yi, and shook his head desperately.The last time my brother looked at the wall and thought about it, he almost starved to death after not giving him food for three days.Or she quietly crawled out of the dog hole and came back with half a piece of steamed bun with the puppy, and her brother was saved.Tang Yi rubbed Tang Yin's head and looked at Tang Jing: "Explain? Mr. Tang seems to have forgotten one thing. What the Tang family eats now is all the money my mother left for me and Yin'er." "It was Yan Shuangyu and her son who occupied the property that should belong to Tang Yin and me." "Don't say I didn't steal it, even if I took it.Yes, it’s my own money.Do I need to explain it to you?”“Master,” Yan Shuangyu said with tears in her eyes, “I don’t want to take over Xiaoyi’s property.I just want to keep it for them because they are young.”Xiao Yi, don't talk nonsense.My mother is very diligent and thrifty!" Tang Hua stood up and looked at Tang Yi with disappointment on his face: "My mother is a virtuous person, but you insult her like this. This is a great act of unfilial piety.If you go to court, you will be whipped." Tang Yi looked at the hypocrite's face and said, "Then.It's your mother!There is only one mother in my life. Her name is Liu Ruyu... Also, you are said to be talented and elegant.Do you have any misunderstandings about the words "virtuous and virtuous"?"You..." Tang Hua choked and turned red on the spot!Damn it, why didn't I realize before that this bastard's mouth was so poisonous?"Stop talking nonsense, Tang Yi. Even if you are eloquent, it can't change the fact that you stole your mother's money." Tang Hao jumped out, pointed at Tang Yi and yelled: "You didn't steal the money. Where did you get the money to buy new clothes and new quilts?" "You are talking nonsense, my brother did not steal the money!" Tang Yin showed his head from behind his brother and yelled loudly.Although she was scared, she would never allow anyone to wrong her brother like this.My brother is so powerful. He can earn hundreds of taels just by sitting on the street. He takes her to eat delicious food and buys her new clothes. He is the best. No one can harm him."My brother and I earned the money together. We didn't steal the money. Third brother, you have wronged me." The little girl blinked and tears fell."Don't cry, we don't need to explain to the trash!" Tang Yi raised his hand and rubbed the girl's head.The girl looked up at her brother and nodded vigorously."The money you made together? Haha, it's so ridiculous. What can you do? Can you make so much money?" Tang Hao sneered at Tang Yin's words and said to Tang Jing: "Dad, this is their excuse. You must not believe them. The money... was stolen by them." "Okay, Hao'er, don't talk to your brother like this." Yan Shuangyu.He raised his hand and grabbed Tang Jing's hand and shook it slightly: "Master, don't be angry. I believe Xiaoyi just took away the money accidentally." "Just say a few words and don't embarrass the child." "We are also responsible for the child's mistakes and need to be taught slowly." Tang Jing glanced at Yan Shuangyu and then put down the chopsticks in his hand.Between Yan Shuangyu and Tang Hua, he naturally chose to believe in Yan Shuangyu."Guizi, let me ask you again, was the silver stolen?" "Yes, return it immediately, otherwise I will check and I will break your legs!" Tang Jing walked towards Tang Yi and said with a gloomy face: "I can accept you being ordinary, or I can accept you not being as good as your elder brother, but I will never accept you being sneaky and letting you go out to embarrass the Tang family."Now, hand over the remaining money!" Yan Shuangyu ran over and grabbed Tang Jing's hand: "Master, don't be so cruel to the child!" After saying this, she looked at Tang Yi with an anxious tone but greed in her eyes: "Xiao Yi, please return the remaining money quickly, you see your father is angry." Tang Hua and Tang Yi stood behind Tang Jing, both holding their hands and sneering at Tang Yi."Oh, it's really lingering!" Tang Yi was too lazy to talk nonsense and stared at Yan Shuangyu and said: "One hundred taels? Mrs. Tang Er, are you sure it is one hundred taels? Right?" Yan Shuangyu nodded slightly and said: "Well, it is one hundred taels." Brothers Tang Hua and Tang Hao also sneered. He was just a waste. Even if he got some silver through some bad luck, it would only be dozens of taels.One hundred taels?He never expected to see so much money in his life!However.The next second, everyone gathered together
